# LAMMPS Input Script for Surface Energy Calculation of Aluminum

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p f

read_data Al_lammps.data

# Replicate the unit cell
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Minimize energy
minimize 1.0e-4 1.0e-6 100 1000

# Compute energy of the slab
variable E_slab equal pe

# Create a bulk system by reapplying periodic boundary in z
displace_atoms all move 0.0 0.0 0.0 units box
boundary p p p

# Minimize energy again
minimize 1.0e-4 1.0e-6 100 1000

# Compute energy of the bulk
variable E_bulk equal pe

# Calculate surface energy
variable A equal lx*ly
variable gamma equal (E_slab - E_bulk)/(2*A)

# Output the surface energy
print "Surface energy (eV/Å²) = ${gamma}"
